correctness.rationale: The nine pairwise-distinct base points are explicitly enumerated on the stated domain; blow-up gives a relatively minimal rational elliptic surface. The symbolic cubic P and line L yield Res(P,L), Disc(P), Disc(PL), the quartic in t and its exact discriminant in a, reproduced by the attached checker. At nonreducible values the singularity is an ordinary node (double P-root) or cusp (triple P-root), with unique cusp at the 71-quadratic locus. All exceptional parameter factors are pairwise coprime. Tangency of line and conic gives III; splitting into three nonconcurrent lines gives I3. For each row the Euler contributions sum to 12. Excluded base-degenerate parameters are not claimed.

value.rationale: The initiating construction was specifically intended as a one-parameter pencil family with four reducible fibers but leaves its singular-fiber geometry open apart from one point. Complete parameter-space stratification into Kodaira baskets detects two intrinsic codimension-one changes (reducible-fiber collisions and cuspidal collision), identifies exact special points and provides the global elliptic degeneration structure; these are natural invariants used in the study of rational elliptic surfaces, rather than an arbitrary point-count slice.
